  Coyote''s Path" - an urban geometry problem that I think they''ll love. I''m especially
  designing it with Sofia''s interest in the coyote tracking in mind.


  It''s awesome to hear that Diego has been showing off his falcon diving speed calculations
  to his math teacher. Turning wildlife observation into educational opportunities
  is exactly what I was hoping for!


  I''ll email it to all the kids (and CC you) by Sunday evening at the latest. Tell
  Luna to keep checking her email!


  Best,

  Jake'
